messages:
ryan: Hey team — need to lock a time for Slate Enterprise (on-prem) deployment review. Customer wants a full checklist run and dry-run validation before the handoff. Prefer sometime next week. 
priya: I'm available Tue/Wed afternoons (PDT). What length do we want? 45m or 60m? 
carmen: 60m please. We'll need PS + customer PM + network lead. I'll invite them. 
devon: Can we add a short triage slot for infra rollback plan and canary thresholds? 10-15m. 
ryan: Agenda draft:
- 10m: Quick customer context & goals (Carmen)
- 15m: Network/KMS/firewall checks (Priya)
- 15m: Serving runtime capacity + canary plan (Devon)
- 10m: Rollback + cutover checklist (Ryan)
- 10m: Action items & owners
priya: Checklist items I want confirmed before call:
- KMS/HSM access verified
- VPC peering + allowed CIDR list
- Customer firewall NAT IPs
- BGP/route propagation test plan
carmen: I'll ask customer for the allowed CIDRs and a point of contact for their network engineer. 
ryan: Quick code ping — I have a tiny terraform change for the onprem bootstrap (net block). PTAL:
```
resource "redwood_onprem_network" "slate" {
  cidr_block = "10.240.0.0/16"
  nat_ips = ["54.12.34.56"]
}
```
Please review for naming and IP conventions. 
maya: will review tf change this afternoon. also can run a dry-run of the bootstrap script in our staging env. 
devon: Note: we'll need to pre-warm cache and KV store. Who can produce a tokenized prompt set for quality smoke tests? 
ryan: I can assemble a 50-prompt smoke set by Monday. 
carmen: Calendar poll: Tue 2026-03-24 16:00 PDT / Wed 2026-03-25 09:00 CET / Wed 2026-03-25 14:00 PDT — please vote. 
priya: voted Tue & Wed afternoon. 
maya: voted Wed only. 
devon: Wed looks best for me. 
ryan: OK locking Wed 2026-03-25 14:00 PDT then. Carmen, can you send the invite with dial-in and agenda? 
carmen: Invite sent to internal attendees + customer PoC. Added agenda and pre-read doc link: https://redwood.company/slate/onprem/pre-read (customer-facing). 
deploy-bot: calendar: Event 'Slate Enterprise — Onprem Deployment Review' scheduled for 2026-03-25 21:00 UTC. 
ryan: Thanks. Owners assigned:
- Priya: network/KMS checks
- Devon: canary/rollback plan + pre-warm
- Ryan: smoke prompts + TF diff review
- Carmen: customer invite + PoC contact
Any blockers we should call out now? 
priya: Need confirmation on HSM access by EOD Monday or we'll need an emergency plan. 
carmen: I'll chase the customer's security lead today. 
ryan: Great. If anyone finds issues with the TF change post them here so we can include in the pre-read. :thumbsup:
